title: pubkit.json's deploy block
description: What a service needs before it deploys. Each need's own keys are its type's schema (pubkit deploy types).
x-phrase: must be an object, with namespace and maybe host, workflow, gate, overlay, units, providers and needs

namespace.description: The k3s namespace the service runs in.
namespace.x-phrase: must be a lower-case name of at most 31 characters

host.description: The public host; it implies dns.site, and service.health asks it.
host.x-phrase: must be a host name in lower case, such as example.example.eu

workflow.description: The deploy workflow's file in .github/workflows (default deploy.yml).
workflow.x-phrase: must be a workflow's file name, such as deploy.yml

gate.description: The repository variable that must be on for the deploy; it implies github.gate.
gate.x-phrase: must be a variable's name: upper case letters, digits and _, not starting GITHUB_

overlay.description: The kustomize overlay the manifest checks render (default k8s).
overlay.x-phrase: must be a directory in the repository, such as k8s

units.description: More units, by name, each its own namespace, overlay, gate and host; a need's unit scopes it to one.
units.x-phrase: must be an object of units, by name

additionalProperties.x-phrase: must be an object, with namespace and maybe overlay, gate and host

providers.description: The packages whose sustenaut.needs types the needs use: ./pubkit runs with each wheel, checked against its sha256.
providers.x-phrase: must be a list of packages, each with distribution, wheel and sha256

items.x-phrase: must be an object with distribution, wheel and sha256

wheel.x-phrase: must be the address of a GitHub release's wheel, NAME-VERSION-py3-none-any.whl

sha256.x-phrase: must be the wheel's sha256, 64 hex digits

needs.description: The needs nothing implies, each an object with type and that type's keys.
needs.x-phrase: must be a list of needs, each an object with a type

items.x-phrase: must be an object with a type
